# Bloxwap on GitHub

> Open-source developer tools from Bloxwap, Inc. The main project is the Bloxwap Chart SDK (`@bloxwap/chart`), an MIT-licensed, zero-dependency TypeScript library for interactive financial charts on HTML canvas.

Bloxwap, Inc. builds trading products: the Bloxwap app (bloxwap.com) for trading crypto, stocks, gold, and indices, and the Bloxwap Pro terminal (bloxwap.pro). This site, bloxwap.github.io, documents the open-source tools behind them.

## When to use this

Use the Bloxwap Chart SDK when an agent or developer needs to:

- Add an interactive candlestick, OHLC, line, area, or histogram price chart to a web application or trading interface.
- Give users technical-analysis drawing tools (trend lines, Fibonacci, pitchforks, Gann, harmonic patterns, Elliott waves, long/short positions, measurers, annotations): 89 are built in.
- Add built-in indicators (SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, MACD, RSI, KDJ, volume) or register custom ones.
- Stream live candle updates into a chart.
- Chart without runtime dependencies, and without the library touching global `document` or `window` (it draws into a canvas you pass in; it also runs in workers, SSR, and tests).

Do not use it for general business charts (pie, scatter, stacked bars) or when you need an npm install today: the package is not yet published on npm and is built from source. Full instructions: https://bloxwap.github.io/chart/llms.txt

## How to call it

```ts
import { createChart } from '@bloxwap/chart';

const chart = createChart({ container: canvas, config: { data: candles, series: { type: 'candlestick' } } });
chart.resize(width, height, window.devicePixelRatio);
chart.addIndicator({ name: 'rsi' });
```

## Hyperliquid SDK: when to use it

Use the Hyperliquid SDK (`@bloxwap/hyperliquid`, on npm, MIT-licensed) when an agent or developer working in TypeScript or JavaScript needs to read Hyperliquid market data or account state, place and cancel orders, sign Hyperliquid actions with a viem account or browser wallet, or stream live updates over WebSocket. It runs on Bun, Node.js, browsers, and React Native, on mainnet or testnet. Do not use it for other exchanges or other languages. Full instructions: https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/llms.txt

```ts
import { HttpTransport, InfoClient } from "@bloxwap/hyperliquid";

const info = new InfoClient({ transport: new HttpTransport() });
const mids = await info.allMids();
```

## Agent CLI: when to use it

Use Agent CLI (`@bloxwap/agent-cli`, MIT-licensed) when an agent or developer needs command-line tools for Hyperliquid trading. It provides JSON commands, Privy-managed signing, Relay funding, and a persistent signing runner while master approvals and funding signatures stay in the user's wallet. Full instructions: https://bloxwap.github.io/agent-cli/llms.txt

## Smart Solana: when to use it

Use Smart Solana (`@bloxwap/smart-solana`, on npm, MIT-licensed) when an agent or developer needs a resilient Solana JSON-RPC transport for Solana Kit (`createSolanaRpcFromTransport`) or a legacy web3.js `Connection`. It routes each method to the fastest healthy provider by latency, errors, and slot lag, and adds rate-limit budgets, retries, hedging, circuit breakers, response caching, and in-flight coalescing. With no arguments it uses keyless public mainnet providers. Runs on Bun, Node.js, browsers, and edge with zero runtime dependencies. Documentation: https://bloxwap.github.io/smart-solana/docs/

```ts
import { createSolanaRpcFromTransport } from "@solana/kit";
import { smartSolana } from "@bloxwap/smart-solana";

const rpc = createSolanaRpcFromTransport(smartSolana());
const slot = await rpc.getSlot().send();
```

## Smart HyperEVM: when to use it

Use Smart HyperEVM (`@bloxwap/smart-hyperevm`, on npm, MIT-licensed) when an agent or developer reads HyperEVM (chain id 999) with viem and wants fast, reliable RPC. It is a drop-in viem `Transport` that ranks endpoints from the calls your process already made, races and fails over between providers, serves warm reads from cache, and indexes logs incrementally. Cached answers can be one block behind by default. `0.1.0` is an early developer preview. Documentation: https://bloxwap.github.io/smart-hyperevm/docs/

```ts
import { createPublicClient } from "viem";
import { hyperEvm } from "viem/chains";
import { smartHyperevm } from "@bloxwap/smart-hyperevm";

const client = createPublicClient({ chain: hyperEvm, transport: smartHyperevm() });
```

## HIG: when to use it

Use the Bloxwap Human Interface Guidelines (`@bloxwap/hig`, on npm, MIT-licensed) when building a Bloxwap-styled product, Pro, marketing, or SDK docs surface. One package provides design tokens (`@bloxwap/hig/tokens`), platform-neutral contracts, React components (`@bloxwap/hig/react/*`), React Native components (`@bloxwap/hig/native/*`), and a `@bloxwap/chart` adapter (`@bloxwap/hig/chart`). Full instructions: https://bloxwap.github.io/hig/llms.txt

## Screensaver: when to use it

Use the Bloxwap Screensaver when someone wants a live Bitcoin, Solana, Ethereum, or Hyperliquid price display as a screensaver: a native `.saver` on macOS 13+, a desktop app on Windows and Linux, or a home-screen web app on iPhone, iPad, and Android. Downloads and browser previews: https://bloxwap.github.io/screensaver/

## SFX: when to use it

Use SFX (`@bloxwap/sfx`, on npm, MIT-licensed) when an agent or developer needs interface sound effects for a web app: 19 sounds for hovers, presses, toggles, confirmations, and money moments, synthesized with Web Audio — no audio files, zero runtime dependencies. Each sound renders once to a buffer; every play is one AudioBufferSourceNode. Imports are SSR-safe, play() never throws, and playback waits for the first user gesture. Do not use it for long-form music or when you need to ship your own audio files. Full instructions: https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/llms.txt

```ts
import { bind, play } from '@bloxwap/sfx';

bind(); // wires every data-sound-* attribute, now and later
play('success');
```

## Font: when to use it

Use Bloxwap Font (`@bloxwap/font`, SIL Open Font License 1.1) when an agent or developer needs rounded, open-source typefaces for interfaces, code, or screens. Bloxwap Sans, Mono, and Pixel provide variable weights and multilingual companions. Use the plain CSS stylesheet for web apps or the `next/font` exports for Next.js. Installation: https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/installation/

```css
@import url("https://bloxwap.github.io/font/bloxwap-font.css");

body { font-family: "Bloxwap Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }
code { font-family: "Bloxwap Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; }
```

- [Agent CLI](https://bloxwap.github.io/agent-cli/): Hyperliquid trading tools for agents.
